issues.description: The flight battery has no specified restraint, electrical protection, venting or clearance from the ESC and other heat sources; a loose or damaged pack is a safety risk.
issues.fix: Define a positive-retention battery compartment, protected pack and connector, insulated routing, thermal clearance and a safe vent path; validate against the applicable battery safety requirements.

issues.description: The shell specification combines an injection-moulded PA12-GF body with carbon-fibre arms, while the BOM lists folding arms separately. The arm-to-shell joint and assembly sequence are undefined.
issues.fix: Specify the arms as separate parts and define hinge inserts, retention, load path, assembly access and inspection criteria.
issues.rule_citation: Define inserts and assembly interfaces before tooling — Protolabs injection molding design guide

issues.description: The self-tapping screw type is unspecified, so the stated boss pilot cannot be verified for installation torque, stripping or repeated battery-service cycles.
issues.fix: Select a specific screw for plastics; validate pilot diameter, engagement, boss outside diameter and installation torque in moulded samples. Use inserts where repeated removal is required.
issues.rule_citation: Size screw bosses and pilot holes to the selected fastener — Protolabs injection molding design guide

issues.description: Shell mating-face tolerances and the split-line step limit lack datum references and an assembled stack-up. Independent part inspection cannot establish whether assembled shells will meet the step limit.
issues.fix: Define locating datums and alignment features, then tolerance the assembled interface using a stack-up and inspection fixture.
issues.rule_citation: Establish datums and control features in relation to assembly function — ISO 1101

issues.description: The PA12-GF enclosure has no flame-rating requirement despite housing a LiPo battery and power electronics. Its UV and saltwater resistance are also unspecified for kitesurf use.
issues.fix: Specify a qualified enclosure grade and required flame rating; validate UV, salt-spray and moisture exposure on finished assemblies.
issues.rule_citation: Plastic-material flammability classification — UL 94; salt-spray testing — ISO 9227

issues.description: No sealing scheme is specified for the shell split, camera, card access, wiring exits or fasteners. Spray and saltwater ingress could damage the electronics.
issues.fix: Set an ingress-protection target and define gaskets, connector seals, drain strategy and production leak-test criteria.
issues.rule_citation: Degrees of protection provided by enclosures — IEC 60529

issues.description: Minimum wall draft is 1.46°: enough for a polished finish, short of the ~3° a textured finish ('Matte · Graphite #3A3D42') needs.
issues.fix: Increase draft to 3° on textured faces, or specify a lighter texture / polished finish.
issues.rule_citation: Draft ≥1° plus 1° per 0.025 mm texture depth — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; measured with text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

measurement.source_or_assumption: Min wall draft vs pull +Z: lowest-draft B-rep wall face ≥ 48.52 mm² (curved, 228.92 mm² at [-46.26, 22.26, 9.76]) — text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

issues.description: Projected area along +Z: 6602 mm² (part silhouette, per cavity). Estimated clamp force ≈ 33.8 t (Estimate: area in² × 3.0 t/in² for PC/ABS × 1.1 safety) — per cavity; a family tool moulding both shells in one shot roughly doubles it.
issues.fix: Quote on a press ≥ 50 t; keep both shells in one family mould only if tonnage allows.
issues.rule_citation: Clamp force ≈ projected area × cavity-pressure factor (2-5 t/in²) — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; silhouette raster from text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

issues.description: Measured wall 2.00-2.00 mm is within the PC/ABS 1.2-3.5 mm range; keep bosses/ribs ≤ 60% of nominal wall to avoid sink.
issues.fix: No change to nominal wall; core bosses and ribs to ≤ 60% of the wall.
issues.rule_citation: PC/ABS wall 1.2-3.5 mm, ribs/bosses ≤ 60% of wall — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines

See also 47 CFR 15.407, 47 CFR 15.19, 47 CFR 15.101, 47 CFR 15.109.
